title: iberis linifolia subsp. violletii
intro: Iberis linifolia subsp. violletii, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and skin conditions, due to its rich content of bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cress include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Rock Cress include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which may help to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress.
